 Order

This is an application filed by the petitioner under Section 483 of BNS for grant of regular bail in case FIR No. 481/2021 under Sections 328/376/376-D/377/384/506 IPC and 6 of POCSO Act .registered at P.S Prem Nagar.
3. Notice is accepted by learned APP appearing for the State who seeks time to file the status report.
4. Status report be filed on or before the next date of hearing.

5. Notice of the petition be also served to the prosecutrix through the Investigating Officer with direction that he shall apprise the prosecutrix about her legal right to have an Advocate from the Legal Aid at State expense.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/08/2025 at 00:07:15 7.
In the meanwhile, the nominal roll of the petitioner be requisitioned from the Superintendent Jail.
